title: NC-ORG-001 · North Carolina Employment Law for Employers — Orange Belt
summary: Orange Belt course for North Carolina organization administrators and small employers: hiring and onboarding, the Wage and Hour Act, the federal overlay and its employee-count thresholds, leave and youth employment, safety, workers' compensation and unemployment insurance, and separation. Legal-information training, not legal advice. Draft, unsigned; pending attorney review.
audience: Organization administrators, owners and managers of small and mid-sized North Carolina employers
disclaimer: This is training, not legal advice.

modules.title: Module 1 · Hiring and onboarding in North Carolina
Module 2 · The Wage and Hour Act
Module 3 · The federal overlay and how it meets North Carolina law
Module 4 · Leave, time off and youth employment
Module 5 · Safety, workers' compensation, unemployment insurance and retaliation
